The spiritual legacy of Mount Athos extends far beyond the peninsula itself, with historic metochia and chapels found throughout Halkidiki. Agioi Theodoroi in Nea Roda reflects this centuries-old tradition, offering a peaceful seaside setting for an Orthodox wedding in Halkidiki.
